summary: Tested the password-auth feature on the live Convex HTTP API (fearless-ostrich-878) and in the Expo web preview at 390x844. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. /auth/start, password login (wrong password, unknown phone, DEVICE_CONFLICT, force), set-password validation and refusal, and /auth/me (has_password present, no hash/salt) all behave as specified. Frontend: login, password step, wrong-password error, device-conflict sheet (yes/no), Enter-to-submit, owner set-password flow (mismatch, rules, eye toggle, Owner12345 saved -> /owner), accountant set-password step + logout, owner tabs (4) and distributor tabs (5) all load in the green theme with no page errors. One HIGH bug: the 'Forgot password' flow never shows the set-new-password step; after the SMS code is verified the user goes straight to the home screen, and there is no other way to change a password. Separately, the test org org_test_1 was SUSPENDED in the DB, so every test user landed on /blocked; I reactivated it with the dev API. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch not in package.json).

minor.issue: The seed only inserts org_test_1 if it is missing. It never resets status, plan or expires_at. The org was found SUSPENDED, so every seeded user landed on /blocked until I ran PATCH /api/dev/orgs/org_test_1 {status:ACTIVE} with test_token_dev.

ui_bugs.issue: 'نسيت كلمة المرور' sets local state resetting=true, then verifyOtp signs the user in. That user has has_password=true and a name, so homeFor() returns dist/owner. Gate in _layout then calls router.replace and unmounts the login screen, which loses resetting=true. The set-new-password step never appears and the password stays unchanged. Reproduced in the web preview with the /auth/otp/request and /auth/otp/verify responses MOCKED via Playwright route (to avoid real SMS): after verify the URL went straight to /dist and set-password-step was not visible. There is also no 'change password' screen anywhere else in the app.

issues: At 390x844 the trial card pushes the phone row (y 702-752) under the sticky footer (continue button starts at y 732). The phone input is half hidden on first view and the user has to scroll.
The ghost buttons login-change-phone and login-forgot-password are 40px tall, and login-start-trial-button is 40px tall. All are below the 44px touch-target minimum.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the forgot-password flow. Keep the reset intent outside the login screen's local state, for example a `pwReset` flag in AuthProvider set by verifyOtp when it starts from 'forgot', or have the backend return user.must_set_password when pw_reset_until is active. Then make homeFor() return 'login' while that flag is set, so Gate does not redirect before the new password is saved.
Consider adding a 'change password' entry in account settings. It can use the forgot/SMS path, since the backend requires pw_reset_until.
Make edge:seedTestAccounts idempotent for org_test_1: patch status=ACTIVE, plan=LICENSE and expires_at=+365d on every run.
Raise the small ghost buttons on the login screen to at least 44px tall, and make sure the phone input is not covered by the sticky footer on 390x844 screens.
critical_code_review_comments: pw.ts: scrypt with a per-user salt, timingSafeEqual and a dummy-salt hash for unknown phones (timing-safe). Fine.

/auth/start returns {method:'password'} or {method:'otp'}, which reveals whether a number has a password. That is an accepted UX trade-off, but it is a mild enumeration vector. Per-phone OTP rate limiting exists.
Per-phone lockout (5 failures -> 15 min) lets anyone lock a known number out of password login. The SMS fallback mitigates this. Acceptable, just noting it.
pwStore correctly refuses to overwrite an existing password unless the session has pw_reset_until (set only on an OTP login), and it revokes the user's other sessions. Verified via API.
homeFor() uses has_password === false (strict), so cached profiles from older builds without the field do not loop. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; forgot-password reset flow broken)

seed_data_creation: Set the owner +963900000002 password to Owner12345 via the UI. Reactivated org_test_1 (it was SUSPENDED) via PATCH /api/dev/orgs/org_test_1. Re-seeded tokens at the end; all 4 test tokens return 200.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests serially: pytest -p no:xdist /app/backend/tests/test_auth_password.py. The force-login test revokes test_token_agent, so re-seed afterwards. Never call /auth/start for numbers that have no password (it sends SMS); test the reset flow by mocking /auth/otp/* with Playwright page.route and a real session obtained from /auth/password/login. Web storage stores session_token in localStorage as a JSON string: localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('test_token_owner')).
rca_of_issue: Forgot-password: login.tsx keeps `resetting` as component state. After verifyOtp, AuthProvider sets user (has_password=true). Gate's effect computes homeFor(user)='dist' and router.replace('/dist') unmounts LoginScreen before the set-password-step renders. Mitigation: move the reset state into the auth context (or the server user payload) and have homeFor return 'login' while a reset is pending.
